title: Lead Break Indicator
description: Adds an indicator above your hotbar of your lead status.
body:
In Minecraft, it's annoying when you're transporting a mob with a leash, and you reach your destination, without your mob.

So this mod fixes all that. Above your hotbar, there is a new, colorful indicator of the status of your leash. 
- Green is for "Great"
- Yellow is for "In Danger"
- Red is for "Broken"

![An image of what the mod does](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43540ad2cef15e039849a568f66d5a7c2697f787.jpeg)
